profile.headline: equal parts computers detective, shepherd, and builder | ex-Etsy
profile.summary: 6 years of experience in operating large scale web application systems and establishing reliability through the facilitation of sustainable observability and incident lifecycle practices

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- updated EKS managed observability pipeline to ship with kube, cloud native best practices (ie prometheus, opentelemetry)
- advocated for furthering sustainable reliability and incident response processes
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon EKS · Pulumi

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- championed organizational observability standards by providing templates and example dashboards that empowered developer teams to establish and iterate on their reliability goals, as well as running onboarding sessions to acclimate new engineers to our observability ecosystem. 
- stablilized and matured Patreon logging infrastructure across a fleet of ansible, spinnaker, and k8s managed services.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon EC2 · Terraform

positions.title: Developer Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
Relevant technologies: Chef, Terraform, Linux, GCP, Kafka, Graphite, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Bazel, Docker

- Maintained and modernized the streaming data platforms that provide Etsy product engineers with the high quality, real-time observability data they rely on for critical alerting and during deploys. 
- Fully migrated all such systems to GCP from on-prem infrastructure without disrupting any of the critical downstream developer services 
- Personally drove onboarding initatives centered around distributed tracing, which included major              optimizations to existing instrumentation and extensive comms including talks, pair programming, group tutorials, and blog posts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Relevant technologies: PHP, REST API design, Hadoop/Scalding, jQuery, React/Redux, feature flagging, AB tests

- Full stack web development with a focus on localization, translation, and other linguistic problem spaces like query suggestion and spelling correction. 
- Collaborated with product managers and designers on mission-critical UIs including the home page, core checkout flow, and search page. Implemented monitoring and alerting to ensure continued stability of these features.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to the development of key under-the-hood tooling that enabled Etsy’s human translated site content to be entered, approved, and edited while remaining decoupled from the production deploy process
- Worked on another deploy adjacent process that allowed Etsy to retain their existing deployment workflows while being able to provide documented evidence of SOX compliance.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Implemented features across core functions such as checkout UI flows and localization that enhanced user purchase experience and expanded international market reach • Built operational tooling for validating PCI, SOX compliance, as well as human translation of site content that improved time to translate and release new features
